purpose: Transfer confirmation of configurations selected using the US discovery screen; no per-country tuning and no inference of country independence.
country_definition: Sum all rows whose Country/Region exactly matches the predeclared country name, including its listed provinces and territories.
source_commit_policy: Resolve HEAD by git ls-remote after this registration, then download only the artifact at that immutable SHA.
target: Nonnegative daily reported case increments: clip first difference of country-aggregated cumulative cases at zero. The first increment is zero.
point_forecast: Cases reported seven calendar days earlier, with no fitted parameters.
nonconformity_score: Absolute difference between current daily cases and daily cases seven days earlier.
normalization: Divide all scores by median of first 115 scores, falling back to their mean if nonpositive, then 1 if still nonpositive. Scale is fixed before evaluation.

initialization_protocols.cold: Initialize every calibrator at score index 115.
initialization_protocols.warm: Initialize every calibrator at score index 0.

reporting: Report all four countries, both initialization protocols, all six methods, actual empirical coverage, widths in original case-count units, longest error streak, and infinite interval fraction. Retain nonwinning/undercovering cases. No per-country tuning, hypothesis test, or independent-country confidence interval.
